tasks.instruction: Read the text below. Fill in each gap (1.1-1.6) with one word to make the text correct.
tasks.text:
The village 1.1. _________ my grandmother grew up has fewer than two hundred inhabitants. There is one shop, 1.2. _________ opens only in the mornings, and a school that closed down years ago. Nearly 1.3. _________ of the young people have moved to the city, so the population keeps falling.

1.4. _________ spite of this, my grandmother refuses to leave. She says she knows every path and every tree, and that she would not be able to sleep in a place 1.5. _________ noisy. Last summer she finally agreed to visit us, 1.6. _________ she went home after only four days.
